values: REST endpoints, request dictionary and response contracts
80 operations  |  English edition  |  Swift & Kotlin clients
Authentication, catalog, reading, library, annotations, downloads, collections, commerce and administration
Request and response definitions follow the current backend implementation. Payment provider integration and PostgreSQL end-to-end verification remain pending.

values: Verifies credentials for an active account and issues bearer tokens.
Only ACTIVE accounts can log in. Admin claims are assigned from server configuration.
Validates the refresh token and reissues tokens for an active account.
Refresh token lifetime: 14 days. Tokens are opaque, not JWT. Deleted/suspended users cannot refresh.
Creates an account with a hashed password and issues bearer tokens.
Email is normalized lowercase; password is hashed. Rate limit: 20 requests/minute per IP.
Returns the authenticated user profile without the password hash.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Updates editable profile fields after validating the timezone.
Email is not editable. Timezone must resolve through TimeZoneInfo.
Deactivates the account while retaining its purchase history.
Soft deletion sets status DELETED. Existing tokens are rejected on later requests.
Returns a page of catalog authors.
Returns a page of published books with optional title and category filters.
Only PUBLISHED books. Title search uses Contains; categoryId filters linked books.
Returns a published book with its authors, categories and published review totals.
Ratings use only PUBLISHED reviews. Password hashes and contentStorageKey are excluded from JSON.
Lists the chapters of a published book in reading order.
Returns a page of published reviews with reviewer display information.
Records a book view once per event key and rejects conflicting key reuse.
eventKey is globally unique. Same user/book retries succeed; conflicting reuse returns 409.
Lists published books ranked by recorded detail views.
Lists active catalog categories in display order.
Returns the user's active library, optionally filtered by reading status.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Adds or restores library membership without granting paid content access.
Library membership alone does not grant paid content access.
Archives the user's library membership without deleting reading history.
Archives membership; reading history and purchased access are retained.
Returns library, reading, wishlist and current-device download counts.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Lists recently viewed published books using the latest view for each book.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Creates or updates the authenticated user's review for a published book.
One review per user/book. Existing moderation status is retained when edited.
Deletes only the authenticated user's review for the book.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Returns a page of the user's saved books in most recently saved order.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Adds a published book to the wishlist without granting reading access.
Wishlist membership can exist outside the library; it grants no reading access.
Removes the book from the authenticated user's wishlist.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Returns the annual target and finished-book count within the user's local year.
Year must be 1–9998. Count uses user-local year boundaries.
Creates or updates the user's annual reading target.
Year must be 1–9998; targetBooks must be greater than zero.
Returns the user's saved reading position and derived completion percentage.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Checks reading access and location before saving progress and completion timestamps.
Requires valid content access; validates page/chapter, restores library membership and maintains finishedAt.
Records a short active reading interval, accepting retries and rejecting overlaps.
Use unique clientSessionKey. UTC whole-second contiguous active intervals, >0 to 60 seconds. Duplicate retry returns existing record; overlapping activity is rejected.
Calculates reading statistics for the selected period in the user's timezone.
Monday weeks. Active time splits at local midnight; page turns are attributed to heartbeat completion day. Month buckets start from month day 1.
Returns a page of the user's annotations, optionally restricted to one book.
kind selects notes, bookmarks or highlights. Results always belong to the authenticated user.
Creates an annotation after checking book access and its content location.
Requires content access. pageNo or nonblank locationToken required; notes/highlights require text; highlights require both anchors.
Updates an owned annotation after checking book access and its content location.
Same validation as create; the annotation must belong to the authenticated user.
Deletes an annotation only when it belongs to the authenticated user.
Owner-only deletion. Returns 404 for another user's annotation.
Checks reading or offline access and returns content metadata and license expiry.
Offline=true requires plan offlineAccess. Returns license renewal deadline and relative authenticated content URL.
Streams a private book file with range support after validating access and storage path.
Requires valid access and configured private storage. Supports HTTP byte ranges. No file is returned if storage is unconfigured.
Returns a page of the user's download records for the specified device.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Checks offline access and file size before saving device download status.
Offline access checked except for REMOVED. Known file size constrains bytesDownloaded; COMPLETED requires full size. License capped at 7 days or source expiry.
Lists accessible collections for the owned, shared, favorites or public tab.
tab = owned / shared / favorites / public. Favorites never grant collection access.
Creates a collection owned by the authenticated user.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Checks collection visibility and membership before returning its books.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Updates collection metadata and visibility only for its owner.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Deletes an owned collection and its related links in one transaction.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Adds or reorders a published book when the user has collection editing access.
Owner or accepted SHARED editor may change membership. Updates collection updatedAt.
Removes a book when the user has collection editing access.
Owner or accepted SHARED editor may remove a book. Updates collection updatedAt.
Favorites a collection only if the user can already access it.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Removes the user's favorite selection without changing collection access.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Lists collection invitations and memberships only for the owner.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Creates or resets a shared-collection invitation for another active user.
Owner-only; collection must be SHARED. Target user must be ACTIVE and cannot be the owner.
Revokes a member's collection access when requested by its owner.
Owner-only. Sets member status REVOKED; personal reading data remains private.
Accepts or declines the authenticated user's pending invitation.
Only a pending INVITED membership can be ACCEPTED or DECLINED.
Lists the authenticated user's pending collection invitations.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Lists the user's recorded access grants, including expired or revoked grants.
Historical grants include revoked/expired records. Use books/{bookId}/access to check current effective access.
Returns a page of the authenticated user's order history.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Creates a pending order using server prices and snapshots its access terms.
Server prices and currency only. One line per book, 1–100 items, same currency. Order remains PENDING until verified callback.
Returns an owned order and its historical book lines.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Cancels an owned order only while it is pending.
Only a PENDING owned order can be cancelled.
Lists the authenticated user's subscription contracts.
User-owned data is scoped to the authenticated user.
Creates a pending subscription that grants no access until verified payment.
Creates PENDING contract; payment provider checkout is not connected.
Cancels an owned subscription while retaining any paid access until period end.
ACTIVE cancellation sets cancelAtPeriodEnd; paid access lasts through endsAt.
Lists active subscription plans available for checkout.
Verifies the signed callback body and processes its payment or refund event.
Trusted internal adapter only. HMAC-SHA256 over exact UTF-8 body with X-BookNest-Signature. Not a direct provider/store webhook. Duplicate successful confirmations are idempotent.
Creates an author record for use in the catalog.
Requires an admin claim assigned by the server.
Updates an existing author's display name and biography.
Requires an admin claim assigned by the server.
Returns a page of catalog books, including draft and archived records, for admins.
Requires an admin claim assigned by the server.
Creates catalog metadata using the validated admin request.
contentStorageKey must be a relative path inside private content storage.
Adds or updates a book-author link and its display order.
Requires an admin claim assigned by the server.
Requires an admin claim assigned by the server.
Adds or updates a book category while keeping at most one primary category.
At most one primary category per book; updates run in a transaction.
Requires an admin claim assigned by the server.
Creates a chapter within the book's valid page range.
Chapter range must satisfy 1 <= startPage <= endPage <= book.pageCount.
Updates an existing chapter belonging to the specified book.
Chapter must belong to the specified book; page range must be valid.
Updates catalog metadata while preserving valid content locations and versions.
Page count cannot invalidate stored locations. Increase contentVersion when replacing content storage key or file format.
Archives a catalog book while preserving its references and purchase history.
Sets status ARCHIVED; keeps purchase history and foreign-key references.
Creates a category after checking its parent hierarchy.
Parent must exist. Category hierarchy cycles are prevented transactionally.
Updates a category after checking its parent hierarchy.
Parent must exist. Category hierarchy cycles are prevented transactionally.
Changes whether a review is published or hidden from public rating totals.
Only PUBLISHED ratings contribute to catalog aggregates.
Creates a subscription plan with its price, billing interval and benefits.
Requires an admin claim assigned by the server.
Updates plan details and benefits without changing existing billing terms.
Billing price, currency and interval are immutable here; create a new plan to change billing terms.
Reports process availability without checking database connectivity.

VIEWER can read; EDITOR can manage books; owner manages invitations and metadata. Favorite never grants access.
Saving or adding a book to the library grants no paid-content access. Valid source and time bounds are checked.
Expiry is capped at earlier source expiry. Premium offline access also requires the plan offlineAccess benefit. Device must enforce cached expiry locally.
Private storage must be configured. Supports range responses; content URL requires bearer authentication.
Contiguous active interval, whole-second UTC times; omit idle time. clientSessionKey permits exact retries; overlaps rejected across devices/books.
Weeks start Monday; month chart uses 7-day buckets from month day 1; year groups by month; all time by year.
Average includes today. Comparison uses equal elapsed prior period; prior zero and all-time comparison return null.
Seconds split at local midnight. Page turns assigned to interval completion day. Rereads count; streak uses consecutive active local dates.

Header X-BookNest-Signature; sign exact UTF-8 JSON bytes using a server-only secret of at least 32 bytes.
Order/refund confirmations must match stored amount and currency. Refund uses original provider reference and full paid amount.
Verified source update, grant creation and library insertion commit together. Paid amount and line terms are immutable.
An ACTIVE cancelled subscription retains paid access until endsAt; PENDING cancellation grants no access.
